author: David East
title: DESIGN.md is now an open specification
summary: Google Labs open-sourced the DESIGN.md draft specification, a shared format to capture design intent and token values for coding agents, enabling easy export/import of design rules across projects and platforms.
key_points: DESIGN.md is now an open specification available on GitHub.
It's a shared format to capture design intent and token values in any project.
It gives coding agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
Instead of guessing, agents know the exact purpose of a color and can validate choices against WCAG rules.
The baseline allows for extension and creativity.
action_items: Review the DESIGN.md specification on GitHub: http://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md
Consider implementing DESIGN.md to standardize design systems for coding agents.
